# Wink & Wear — Master AI & LLM Discovery Profile (https://winkandwear.com)

> Premium E-Commerce Fashion Platform for Men, Women, and Kids with an Integrated Google Gemini AI Shopping Assistant (Winkie).

## Core Information
- Platform Name: Wink & Wear
- Primary Website: https://winkandwear.com
- Target Audience: Men, Women, Kids (India & Global E-Commerce)
- Primary Offerings: Streetwear T-Shirts, Casual Shirts, Jackets, Denim, Women's Dresses, Activewear, Kids Apparel
- Interactive Feature: Winkie AI Chatbot for 24/7 styling advice, size assistance, and direct product recommendations.
